about: The standard repo layout, machine-readable. The prose is durable-knowledge, 'Repo layout'; tools/check.py fails if the prose's tree, four-questions table or forbidden names differ from this file. Read by tools/layout-check, which also writes the template's stubs from it.

entries.line: START HERE. What this is, how to run it, and a table of every top-level entry
Rules for AI agents. The only copy
One line: @AGENTS.md   (so Claude Code loads the same file)
The four files below, runbooks/, and any project-specific CAPITALS files
Where things stand today and the next step (pick up here)
How it works and what it is meant to be
What was decided and why: D1, D2, ... with an index at the top

entries.short: what to do when it breaks
entries.line: What to do when something breaks, or how to do a job: one file each, verb-noun.md
The code (or the folder the language or engine expects; README's table names it)
Scripts people and CI run. tools/check.sh runs every check CI runs
Runs every check CI runs, layout-check first
CI (.github/workflows/ while a repo still lives on GitHub)

forbidden.why: logs never go in a repo, tracked or not
forbidden.fix: move it to a scratch folder outside the repo

forbidden.why: scratch never goes in a repo, tracked or not
forbidden.fix: move it to a scratch folder outside the repo

forbidden.why: secrets never go in a repo
forbidden.fix: git rm --cached .env, add .env to .gitignore, commit a .env.example

questions.question: How do I run it?
questions.where: `README.md`, section "Run it" (the first section after one paragraph saying what it is)

questions.question: What do I do when it breaks?

work_tracking.about: Open work (bugs, roadmap items, review findings not fixed) lives in the issue tracker, one issue each. durable-knowledge, 'Repo layout', 'Open work lives in the issue tracker'.

forms.about: The second allowed form of the decisions and status homes, for repos where many branches land in parallel (durable-knowledge, 'Repo layout', 'Per-file decisions and status'; D12). A repo selects each one with its line in .layout-check, `form <name>: <reason>`. Without the line, the folder is an unknown docs folder.

decision-files.file_hint: Dnnn.md, the decision's number in three or more digits (D7 is D007.md)
decision-files.line: form decision-files: one file per decision, docs/decisions/Dnnn.md; docs/DECISIONS.md says where they are and how to add one

status-entries.line: form status-entries: one entry per branch, docs/status.d/<slug>.md, folded into docs/STATUS.md at landing
